description: Search Strong Saga's compared and ranked home gym gear with a plain-language query, e.g. "walking pad for a 300 lb person" or "power rack under $500 for a 7 ft ceiling". Returns results with id, title (name, guide rank and guide price) and url (the Strong Saga guide to cite). Call fetch with an id for the full record and its buy link. Same data as answer_home_gym_question, in the search/fetch shape ChatGPT connectors and deep research use.
name: search
title: Search home gym gear (connector shape)
